summary: Comprehensive testing of Synthetic User Testing tool. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed covering health, seed panel with 5 personas, and full CRUD (create/list/get/patch/delete + persistence verification) for runs, steps, signals, and persona-panels. Also validated 422 on bad enum and 404 on missing resource. Frontend: All 5 pages navigate correctly (Live Grid, Persona Panels, Reports, Cross-Stage Diff, New Run). Live Grid renders exactly 5 persona tiles from seeded panel; Meera tile correctly shows AX-tree transcript (not icon). Persona Panels page shows the seed panel card, New Panel dialog opens/closes. Reports & Cross-Stage Diff show empty-state placeholders. New Run form accepts inputs, panel select works, submit creates a run and navigates back to Live Grid where the run card appears with 'Running' badge. Toast 'Run started' confirmed.

minor.issue: Passing a non-24-char string to any ObjectId route raises unhandled bson.errors.InvalidId → returns 500 instead of 400/404. Consider try/except ObjectId(...) in each handler.
severity_min=0 is treated as falsy so filter is skipped; use `is not None` check.
@app.on_event('startup')/'shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.

issues: Two nested elements both carry data-testid='new-run-stage-select' and 'new-run-panel-select' (on <Select> wrapper and on <SelectTrigger>) causing duplicate test IDs. Only put testid on the trigger.

action_items: Wrap ObjectId(id) conversions in try/except to return 400/404 instead of 500 for malformed IDs.
Remove duplicate data-testid on the Select wrapper in NewRun.jsx (keep only on SelectTrigger).
Migrate startup/shutdown events to FastAPI lifespan API (deprecation warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes routes + models + seed in one file; will grow past 700 lines - split into models.py, routes/*.py, seed.py before extending.
Run.persona is `dict` with no schema; consider a nested Pydantic model for stronger validation.
DELETE run cascades to steps/signals which is good, but there is no test for cascade — added coverage recommended.
No pagination totals returned from list endpoints (only paginated list). Frontend cannot display total counts.
seed_data_creation: Startup hook seeds one persona_panel with client_ref='seed-demo' containing 5 personas. Verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test data prefixed with TEST_. Clean-up of TEST_ runs handled inline. Duplicate data-testids on the two Select components in NewRun.jsx are noted but do not block Playwright (first match works).
